answer: Reputation propagates through the EigenTrust trust matrix with exponential temporal decay: its half-life makes influence depend on sustained honest service, not a brief burst. Reciprocity-weighted transitive links reinforce behavior vouched for by established peers, while freshly spawned sybils have negligible trusted incoming weight and near-zero eigenvector centrality. A spiral of mutually endorsing identities, labeled copper or lagoon, still cannot meet consensus thresholds without credibility accumulated over time.
